notes.title: PBA Basketball Slam is now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey Basketball Fans!

We are very happy to announce that PBA Basketball Slam Arcade Edition is now available!  Get it now at 25% Off until September 7, 2020!

[previewyoutube=vhp0IvgsTsw;full][/previewyoutube]

The early access version will allow you to play up to 4 players (2v2), to make it juicier we have decided to unlock all the court locations for you to enjoy! Since the game is in Early Access, please do expect some bugs to creep into the game, if you experience any problems or if you have any suggestions to make this arcade basketball game better just let us know and we will get into it! Join us on discord so you can chat directly with us!

Here are the current game features!

Complete PBA Teams (they're cool!)
6 FREE court locations to play
Full controller support gameplay
Play up to 4 players! Go head to head with your friends on local multiplayer!
No controllers? No Problem! Play using your keyboard on a single player game!
Play online using Steam Remote Play! - Easy to setup! Just right click on your steam friend and invite them to the game! (Controllers required)
Supports different commentator language - Filipino, English, Spanish and Portuguese! (MORE TO COME!)


Plus we have more features to come!
Campaign Mode
Shop and Locker
Create your own player and more!
